blurb: Joey Flats Fishing is a top charter fishing company offering South Florida fishing charters out of the famed inshore fishing destination of Flamingo Everglades National Park (ENP). Joey Flats Fishing knows the Flamingo and Everglades National Park intimately, and targets a variety of fish species like Tarpon, Snook, Redfish, Trout, Black Drum, Goliath Grouper, Gag Grouper, Permit, Cobia, Sharks and more.
